Elite anchor – VP Talent Acquisition / Recruiting Executive (rare_air 92–96)
LAUREN KIM
VP, Talent Acquisition
New York, NY • lauren.kim@example.com • (555) 555-0175 • linkedin.com/in/laurenkimta

SUMMARY
Talent executive with fifteen plus years building and scaling recruiting teams for high growth technology companies. Known for combining executive level partnership with hands-on funnel ownership. Track record of doubling engineering orgs, lifting offer acceptance, and improving quality of hire while reducing cost per hire.

EXPERIENCE

Vice President, Talent Acquisition
Helios Systems – New York, NY
Mar 2020 – Present

Lead a 65 plus person global recruiting organization covering engineering, product, go to market, and G A for a company that grew from 800 to 2,300 employees and from 150 million dollars to 600 million dollars ARR.

Partnered with CEO, CHRO, and functional VPs to build a three year headcount plan and quarterly hiring reviews, increasing hiring plan accuracy from 62 percent to 91 percent and reducing last minute hiring escalations by 70 percent.

Rebuilt the engineering recruiting funnel, improving onsite to offer from 21 percent to 33 percent and offer acceptance from 76 percent to 89 percent while maintaining bar and increasing representation of underrepresented groups in senior roles.

Introduced a structured interviewing program with calibrated loops, hiring manager training, and a centralized question bank, reducing time to fill by 23 days on average and cutting mis hire rate in the first six months by 35 percent.

Implemented core systems upgrades including a new ATS, scheduling automation, and a sourcing CRM, reducing recruiter time spent on coordination by 30 percent and increasing sourced hire contribution from 18 percent to 32 percent.

Built and mentored a senior leadership bench of 4 Directors of TA across regions and functions, with 2 promoted from internal pipeline.

Senior Director, Talent Acquisition
Northline Technologies – San Francisco, CA
Jul 2014 – Feb 2020

Scaled the company from 300 to 1,000 employees, with a focus on R D and enterprise sales hiring.

Launched a university recruiting and early career program that generated 120 plus hires over three years with a 92 percent one year retention rate.

Partnered with Finance to establish a headcount forecasting and requisition approval process that improved budget adherence and reduced last minute backfills.

Introduced recruiter enablement and playbooks that improved average recruiter productivity from 3.1 to 4.5 hires per month.

Director, Recruiting
BrightSide Digital – Boston, MA
Jan 2010 – Jun 2014

Built the recruiting function from 3 to 15 people and established the company’s first structured hiring process.

Led hiring for critical roles including VP Sales, VP Product, and VP Engineering, partnering closely with the CEO and board.

EDUCATION

B.S. Business Administration – Human Resources
Northeastern University

SKILLS

Hiring: executive search partnership, technical recruiting strategy, go to market hiring

Leadership: org design, headcount planning, recruiter enablement, performance management

Systems: Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Gem, LinkedIn Recruiter, Ashby

Practices: structured interviews, compensation calibration, diversity strategy, executive reporting

OTHER LINE REWRITES

Useful edits, kept with their own source.

These do not map uniquely to the ranked fixes above, so each stays beside the exact line it rewrites.

LINE EDIT 01 · SOURCE LINE

“Built the recruiting function from 3 to 15 people and established the company’s first structured hiring process.”

REWRITE

Built BrightSide Digital's recruiting function from 3 to 15 people and established the company's first structured hiring process; hiring result: [number of hires or change in time to fill].

Add a hiring or speed result to show what the new function delivered beyond its size.

QUESTIONS WORTH ANSWERING

Prompts for your next revision.

These questions are not tied to a specific ranked fix. Use whichever ones surface a true, useful detail.

QUESTION 01

What changed in quality of hire after the Helios recruiting funnel rebuild?

Why it may help: The summary names quality of hire, but the Helios bullets quantify funnel and acceptance changes instead.

QUESTION 02

How many hires did the 65 plus person Helios organization deliver during growth from 800 to 2,300 employees?

Why it may help: The organization and company growth are clear, but hiring volume would show the operating scale.

QUESTION 03

What hiring tradeoff did you manage while improving onsite to offer and offer acceptance?

Why it may help: The funnel metrics are strong, and the decision-making behind maintaining the bar would add useful senior-level context.

QUESTION 04

Which recruiter behavior changed after the Northline playbooks raised productivity from 3.1 to 4.5 hires per month?

Why it may help: The productivity result is useful, but the mechanism is currently compressed into a program label.

QUESTION 05

How did CEO and board priorities shape the VP Sales, VP Product, and VP Engineering searches at BrightSide?

Why it may help: The senior stakeholders and roles are named, but the complexity of those searches is not yet visible.

KEEP THESE

The parts already earning trust.
01

Helios combines a 65 plus person global team with coverage across engineering, product, go-to-market, and G A, making the operating remit easy to place.

02

The funnel metrics move from 21 percent to 33 percent onsite-to-offer and from 76 percent to 89 percent offer acceptance, which gives the recruiting work a concrete business shape.

03

The leadership bench includes 4 Directors of TA, with 2 promoted internally, showing that team development was part of the role rather than an aside.

ROLE DIRECTION

Where this story reads strongest.

Position yourself for VP Talent Acquisition and recruiting executive roles at scaling technology companies. Lead with global team size, workforce planning, funnel economics, hiring quality, and leadership development, then use earlier roles to show you built functions from the ground up.

BEST FIT NOW
